bagPolicy.summary: 9:30 Club sets no bag size limit. Every bag is searched, and staff may ask you to check a larger bag in the coat room.
allowed: Bags of any size after search
prohibited: Weapons of any kind, including chains and spikes
Outside food, beverages, cans, bottles and coolers
Flags, signs or banners larger than 8.5" x 11"
bagPolicy.note: The venue asks guests to leave bags at home if possible. Coat check is seasonal at $5 per item, and there is no place to check jackets or bags in warmer weather.

parking.summary: Official venue guidance provides event parking information; lists a rate starting at $20.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The reviewed official venue guidance does not state a specific rideshare guidance.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Official venue guidance says alcoholic beverages are available for purchase at events.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: To request accommodations, including seating and ASL interpreters, call the box office at 202-265-0930. ASL interpreter requests must be made at least two weeks before the show.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is allowed on most nights. Confirm the rule for your show before leaving.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Official venue guidance provides box-office information and lists hours of 12:00pm – 7:00pm.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: If you want to be up front or along the balcony railing, get in line before doors open. Even then, people may be ahead of you and no spot inside is guaranteed.
